checklist.title: Banner Grabbing & Service Fingerprinting
checklist.description: Identify the exact OpenSSH version and underlying OS distribution.

checklist.title: Weak Ciphers & Algorithms Check
checklist.description: Enumerate supported algorithms to find deprecated or vulnerable ciphers.

checklist.title: Username Enumeration
checklist.description: Attempt to enumerate valid usernames if older OpenSSH versions (<= 7.7) are in use.

checklist.title: Credential Brute-Forcing
checklist.description: Test weak or default passwords against known user accounts.

checklist.title: Vulnerability Research & Exploit Check
checklist.description: Check for known vulnerabilities like Debian PRNG or specific OpenSSH CVEs.
